 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 7 13-09-2024 1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.P.P. for the State and the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the OP No. 2.
2.

The petitioner seeks bail in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 406, 354, 376, 511 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner, right from the outset, had admitted that OP No. 2 is his legally wedded wife, it is also submitted that petitioner has remained in custody for nearly six months and thereafter he was granted the privilege of provisional bail.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.21877 of 2024(7) dt.13-09-2024 3.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the OP No. 2 also does not oppose the bail application of the petitioner.
